lines.en: I was going to call him, but you came to tell him you love him.
I knew it! I was right! I'm right, right?
I'd really rather talk to him.
Do you have any idea where he is?
Ross, I don't know if you can hear this,
but I'm going to talk anyway.
I'm in the States with your sister and your friends,
and it's all over with Colin.
I came here to tell you that and to tell you...
Yes, Joey, you can have all the chocolate you want, just take it.
I came here to tell you...
I'm going to call you right now
right now from the phone booth.
